title: Senior Business Analyst - Supply Chain
description:
Who We Are

We are an IFS integrator, providing end-to-end ERP implementation projects and exceptional support services. As strategic business partners, we collaborate with clients across key industries, helping them drive digital transformation.

Our global team of 200+ members brings extensive expertise, including former IFS customers who understand real-world operational challenges and dedicated IFS specialists with deep functional and technical knowledge. Together, we deliver outstanding services to reshape businesses and optimize supply chain operations.

Who We Are Looking For

We are currently seeking a Senior Business Analyst – Supply Chain , a client-facing leadership role responsible for driving complex ERP implementations within supply chain domains (procurement, inventory, logistics, planning, and distribution).

This role requires a strong functional expert who can lead requirement gathering, solution design, and implementation while acting as a key advisor to clients and an escalation point for junior analysts.

If you are passionate about supply chain optimization, ERP transformation, and leading cross-functional collaboration in global projects, we encourage you to apply.

Key Responsibilities

Business Requirements & Client Engagement

• Lead requirement gathering sessions with stakeholders across supply chain functions.

• Analyze business processes (procurement, inventory, warehousing, logistics) to identify improvements and optimization opportunities.

• Translate complex supply chain and technical concepts into clear language for non-technical stakeholders.

• Perform gap analysis between current operations and ERP capabilities, ensuring scalable and efficient solutions.

• Advise clients on best practices aligned with industry standards and digital transformation strategies.

Solution Design, Implementation & Testing

• Lead supply chain module implementation within ERP (IFS or similar).

• Supervise and mentor Business Analysts and Junior Analysts within the domain.

• Collaborate with Project Managers on planning, estimations, and risk mitigation.

• Work closely with development and technical teams to ensure accurate solution delivery.

• Lead design discussions to align system architecture with business objectives.

• Ensure quality assurance testing and validation of supply chain functionalities.

• Support cross-functional alignment with Solution Architects and other domains.

• Deliver user training sessions and create functional documentation to ensure adoption.

Training, Expertise & Continuous Improvement (20%)

• Act as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) in supply chain processes and ERP functionalities.

• Stay up to date with industry trends, including digital supply chain, automation, and best practices.

• Maintain relevant certifications (IFS or equivalent ERP modules).

• Drive continuous improvement initiatives across projects and internal practices.

Must Have

• Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Industrial Engineering, Business, or related field.

• Minimum 5 years of experience in supply chain processes (procurement, logistics, inventory, planning).

• Minimum 3 years in client-facing roles.

• Experience in ERP implementation projects (IFS preferred).

• Strong understanding of supply chain operations across industries such as Manufacturing, Energy, Construction, or Services.

• Fluent in Portuguese and English (Spanish or French is a plus).

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

• Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving capabilities.

• Experience with project management and collaboration tools.

• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office.

• Availability to travel.

• Legally authorized to work in Brazil.

What We Offer

• Competitive salary and benefits package.

• Career growth opportunities with certifications and professional development.

• A collaborative and international work environment.

• Involvement in high-impact global supply chain transformation projects.

Why Hoist?

If you are looking for an opportunity to lead impactful supply chain transformations and grow your career in a dynamic and global environment, Hoist is the place for you.

Join our team and be part of a people-first culture that values collaboration, innovation, and professional growth.

title: Keeta Shop Manager
description:
Role Overview

The Keeta Shop Manager will lead the development and operations of Keeta’s merchant supply business in Brazil. This role is responsible for ensuring timely delivery of materials, launching and scaling Keeta Shop, and building a structured supply model that supports merchant operations and long-term growth.

Job Responsibilities

1. Operational Excellence & On-Time Delivery

  • Own and improve On-time Delivery Rate for merchant material distribution
  • Manage end-to-end logistics for New Merchant Kits
  • Coordinate with procurement, warehouse, and delivery partners
  • Monitor inventory levels and prevent stockouts
  • Establish SLA tracking and operational dashboards

2. Keeta Shop Launch & Scaling

  • Lead the launch of Keeta Shop ordering flow for merchants
  • Design and optimize the reorder process within the platform
  • Define pricing, margin structure, and minimum order policies
  • Drive adoption among active merchants
  • Drive adoption among active merchants

3. Supplier & Category Management

  • Identify and negotiate with suppliers for packaging materials and core SKUs
  • Manage vendor relationships, pricing agreements, and payment terms
  • Expand catalog strategically into selected ingredients (e.g., flour, cheese, tomato sauce)
  • Evaluate SKU performance, margin, and operational feasibility
  • Develop roadmap for expanded supply offering

4. Cross-Functional Coordination

  • Align with Merchant Experience and BD teams on onboarding kits
  • Partner with Finance on margin control and cost structure
  • Coordinate with Product/Tech for Shop platform improvements
  • Support marketing initiatives related to Keeta Shop adoption

5. Performance & Reporting

  • Own main OKRs: On-time Delivery Rate, Internal NPS, Successful Keeta Shop Launch
  • Provide monthly performance reporting and improvement plans
  • Identify operational risks and propose mitigation strategies

Job Requirements

1. Experience

  • Extensive experience in supply chain, procurement, operations, or marketplace supply business
  • Experience in B2B supply, retail distribution, food supply, or marketplace operations is preferred
  • Experience launching or scaling operational programs is a strong plus

2. Skills & Competencies

  • Strong operational mindset with attention to detail
  • Data-driven decision making
  • Experience managing vendors and negotiating contracts
  • Strong cost and margin awareness
  • Ability to build processes from scratch in fast-growing environments
  • Ability to build processes from scratch in fast-growing environments
  • Strong ownership and accountability

3. Profile

  • Structured and organized
  • Hands-on and execution-oriented
  • Comfortable in high-growth, ambiguous environments
  • Strong problem-solving skills
  • Able to balance short-term execution with long-term planning

title: Técnico de Operação e Manutenção III
description:

1. Apoio às Atividades Técnicas

  • Utilizar corretamente EPIs e zelar pelo cumprimento das normas aplicáveis às atividades de laboratório.

  • Colaborar para um ambiente seguro, ordenado e eficiente.

6. Requisitos:

  • Vivência prévia em laboratório, operação de equipamentos de teste ou manutenção técnica.
  • Conhecimento em interpretação de desenhos, esquemas e especificações técnicas.
  • Calibração, instrumentação ou ensaios laboratoriais.
  • Desejável conhecimentos técnicos em metrologia e calibração de instrumentos.
  • Leitura e interpretação de normas técnicas (ABNT, IEC, ISO etc.).
  • Noções de análise de falhas (FMEA, RCA).
  • Sistemas de gestão da qualidade (ISO 9001) e segurança (NRs).
  • Formação técnico completo em eletronica, mecânica, elétrica ou relacionados.

A fabricação de parques eólicos no segmento onshore é nossa principal competência e paixão há mais de 35 anos. Com mais de 28 GW de capacidade instalada em todo o mundo, nossas turbinas fornecem energia sustentável a mais de 80% do mercado global de energia e somos uma das maiores empresas do setor eólico. Estamos presentes em mais de 25 mercados e temos instalações de produção na Alemanha, Espanha, Brasil, EUA, México e Índia oferecem aos nossos mais de 6.500 funcionários a oportunidade de cooperação internacional e intercultural. Se você é apaixonado por energias renováveis, adora trabalhar em equipe e compartilha nossos valores de integridade, companheirismo, respeito e empreendimento. Gostaríamos que você fizesse parte!

title: Bolsista Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial - APS3 TECNOLOGIA - Estruturação completa da área de Recursos Humanos da APS3
description:
A Fundação Araucária, em parceria com o IEL Paraná, oferece às empresas paranaenses um programa inovador que conecta seu negócio a doutores profissionais. O Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial oportunizará expertise técnica, científica e metodológica, essenciais para impulsionar o crescimento, a inovação e aumentar a sustentabilidade da sua empresa, fortalecendo seu posicionamento no cenário competitivo.

O programa oferece bolsas para a inserção de doutores em empresas paranaenses , promovendo o desenvolvimento científico, tecnológico e de inovação. Os bolsistas atuarão diretamente na empresa, contribuindo com conhecimento de ponta e soluções personalizadas para o mercado , ancoradas na ciência e em evidências robustas.

Mais do que uma ponte entre academia e setor produtivo, o programa fomenta a aplicação prática do conhecimento científico , favorecendo a transformação de pesquisas em inovações reais, com alto impacto socioeconômico . A atuação dos doutores promove a cultura da ciência nas organizações, estimula a tomada de decisão baseada em dados e evidências , e potencializa a capacidade de resolver desafios complexos de forma criativa e sustentável .

Sobre a Oportunidade:

Desde 2012 a APS3 atua como agente SIEMENS, auxiliando as empresas a trilharem seu caminho rumo à digitalização e atuando nos mais diversos tipos de indústria. Especialista em MOM (Manufacturing Operations Management) e em PLM (Product Lifecycle Management), a APS3 cobre as áreas de venda, consultoria, implantação e suporte do Opcenter APS / Preactor, do Opcenter X e do Teamcenter PLM, soluções líderes de mercado na transformação digital / digitalização. A APS3 ouve seus desafios e objetivos de negócios e, em seguida, colabora com você para desenvolver uma solução de tecnologia adaptada ao seu negócio e sua indústria. Como tem experiência em ajudar muitas empresas de vários segmentos industriais, a APS3 trabalhará com você para garantir um sucesso semelhante para sua empresa .

O objetivo desse projeto é implantar um sistema robusto de gestão de pessoas que contemple trilhas de carreira, avaliação contínua de desempenho, Programas de Desenvolvimento Individual (PDI) e iniciativas estruturadas de engajamento e clima organizacional, assegurando o crescimento sustentável da empresa e a satisfação dos colaboradores.

Projeto: Estruturação completa da área de Recursos Humanos da APS3.

Formação Acadêmica:

Doutorado completo em Psicologia, Administração ou Recursos humanos.

Defesa da tese há, no máximo, 5 anos.

Principais Atividades:

  • Diagnóstico e Estruturação de Cargos e Carreiras.
  • Implementação do Sistema de Avaliação de Desempenho.
  • Criação e Gestão de Planos de Desenvolvimento Individual (PDI).
  • Desenvolvimento de Políticas de Engajamento e Clima Organizacional.
  • Capacitação e Desenvolvimento de Lideranças.
  • Consolidação e Documentação dos Processos de RH.
  • Avaliação Final e Planejamento Estratégico de RH.

Requisitos Técnicos Mínimos:

  • Conhecimento intermediário dos principais aplicativos office (Excel, Word e PowerPoint).
  • Experiência profissional ou acadêmica com avaliação de desempenho, plano de desenvolvimento pessoal e com estruturação de plano de carreira.

Requisitos Técnicos Desejáveis / Diferenciais

  • Já ter trabalhado em empresa na área de RH.
  • Conhecimento em testes comportamentais como DISC ou similares.
  • Já ter atuado em empresas de tecnologia.

Valor da bolsa (mensal) : Bolsista (Doutor) R$ 5.000 – Programa Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial

title: Subject Matter Expert - Chartered & Certified Accountants (Remote)
description:
Start Date: Ongoing

Screener Criteria: Active professional certification (CPA, ACCA, ACA, etc.)

Eligible Locations:

Language Requirement: Fluent English

Type of contract: Freelance / On-Call Advisory

Hourly Rate: $60.00

Minimum Hours: No minimum

Maximum Hours: Ad hoc / Subject to project availability

About Prolific

Prolific is not just another player in the AI space. We are building the biggest pool of quality human data in the world.

Over 35,000 AI developers, researchers, and organisations use Prolific to gather data from paid study participants with a wide variety of experiences, knowledge, and skills.

The Opportunity

We are inviting Certified Accountants to join our global network of Subject Matter Experts (SMEs). This is not a traditional accounting role; instead, you will be providing expert-level analysis for B2B and AI Research projects that require a deep understanding of fiscal regulations, reporting standards, and financial logic.

Please note: This is a "bench" model. By verifying your credentials, you gain eligibility for high-level research tasks as they become available. Access is based on project demand and professional profile matching.

What you’ll be doing

When selected for an active project, your tasks will involve:

  • Professional document analysis: Reviewing complex financial statements, audit reports, and regulatory filings to ensure data integrity.
  • Domain-specific validation: Answering knowledge-based questions that require an active understanding of international or local accounting standards.
  • Business logic synthesis: Providing the professional "human-in-the-loop" oversight that ensures B2B research is accurate and enterprise-ready.

What you’ll bring

  • Active certification: You must hold a valid, verifiable professional license (e.g., CPA, ACCA, ACA, CIMA, or regional equivalent).
  • Technical rigor: The ability to navigate long-form financial documents and extract precise information under research conditions.
  • Global perspective: We welcome qualified accountants from around the world who can apply their local or international standards to complex datasets.
  • Integrity: All participants must undergo a verification process to confirm their active professional standing.

Why join this project?

This is a flexible, high-rate opportunity to apply your specialised certification to the forefront of global business research. At $60 per hour , you can contribute your expertise on an ad hoc basis that fits perfectly around your existing clients or firm commitments.

Why Prolific is a great platform to join as an expert participant

Joining our platform as a participant will give you the chance to influence the AI models of the future. Once you pass our assessment, you can join Prolific in just 15 minutes and start enjoying competitive pay rates, flexible hours, and the ability to work from home.

We've built a unique platform that connects researchers and companies with a global pool of participants, enabling the collection of high-quality, ethically sourced human behavioral data and feedback. This data is the cornerstone of developing more accurate, nuanced, and aligned AI systems.

We believe that the next leap in AI capabilities won't come solely from scaling existing models, but from integrating diverse human perspectives and behaviors into AI development. By providing this crucial human data infrastructure, Prolific is positioning itself at the forefront of the next wave of AI innovation – one that reflects the breadth and the best of humanity.

Links to more information on Prolific

Privacy Statement

By submitting your application, you agree that Prolific may collect your personal data for recruiting and global organization planning. Prolific's explains what personal information Prolific may process, where Prolific may process your personal information, its purposes for processing your personal information, and the rights you can exercise over Prolific's use of your personal information.

title: Desenvolvedor sênior
description:
Desenvolvedor Full Stack- SÊNIOR

SOBRE A MBRAS

A MBRAS é uma incorporadora e imobiliária de alto padrão com atuação em São Paulo. Combinamos a sofisticação do mercado de luxo com uma operação tecnológica de ponta, utilizando inteligência artificial e dados proprietários para transformar a experiência do mercado imobiliário brasileiro.

Nosso braço de tecnologia, o IBVI (Instituto Brasileiro de Valuation Imobiliário), desenvolve soluções de proptech com uma base de milhões de registros, processamento de dados em larga escala e inteligência artificial aplicada ao setor imobiliário.

SOBRE A POSIÇÃO

Buscamos um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Full Stack para atuar no coração da nossa operação tecnológica, construindo e evoluindo as plataformas que sustentam o ecossistema IBVI e a operação digital da MBRAS. Você trabalhará com um stack moderno — TypeScript no frontend e backend, PostgreSQL, Supabase e serviços em Rust — entregando soluções que processam dados em larga escala e alimentam produtos de inteligência imobiliária.

RESPONSABILIDADES

  • Desenvolver e manter aplicações web com Next.js/React no frontend e Hono (TypeScript) no backend, integradas ao Supabase
  • Projetar e implementar APIs REST e/ou GraphQL para consumo de dados imobiliários, busca e inteligência de leads
  • Trabalhar com PostgreSQL (Neon) em escala — queries otimizadas, particionamento, materialized views e migrações
  • Integrar e consumir serviços de busca (Meilisearch) e analytics (DuckDB) no ecossistema de dados
  • Implementar interfaces sofisticadas seguindo o design system da marca (quiet luxury aesthetic, tipografia editorial)
  • Colaborar com o time de IA e dados para integrar modelos e pipelines de enriquecimento de dados
  • Contribuir para a infraestrutura cloud (Fly.io, Cloudflare, Google Cloud, Neon) e pipelines de CI/CD
  • Participar de decisões de arquitetura, code reviews rigorosos e cerimônias ágeis

REQUISITOS OBRIGATÓRIOS

  • Residir na cidade de Sao Paulo (Imprescindível)
  • 3+ anos de experiência como desenvolvedor full stack com TypeScript em produção
  • Domínio de React/Next.js no frontend e Node.js (Express, Hono, NestJS ou similar) no backend
  • Experiência sólida com PostgreSQL — modelagem relacional, performance tuning e migrations
  • Familiaridade com ORMs/query builders (Drizzle, Prisma, TypeORM) e Supabase
  • Conhecimento de Git flow, CI/CD e boas práticas de versionamento
  • Experiência com testes automatizados (Jest, Vitest, Playwright ou equivalente)
  • Capacidade de navegar entre frontend e backend com autonomia e qualidade
  • Comunicação clara e proatividade em ambiente de equipe enxuta e alto impacto

DIFERENCIAIS

  • Experiência com Rust (Axum, Actix) para serviços de alta performance
  • Conhecimento de Meilisearch, Elasticsearch ou motores de busca full-text
  • Familiaridade com DuckDB, ClickHouse ou ferramentas de analytics em larga escala
  • Experiência com deploy em Fly.io, Cloudflare Workers ou plataformas serverless/edge
  • Noções de arquitetura de dados — ETL, pipelines, deduplicação e enriquecimento
  • Experiência prévia em proptech, fintech ou startups de dados
  • Contribuições open-source ou projetos pessoais relevantes publicados

O QUE OFERECEMOS

  • Salário compatível com o mercado de tecnologia
  • Modelo híbrido com escritório no Cidade Jardim Corporate Center
  • Acesso a ferramentas de IA de ponta (Claude, GitHub Copilot, ferramentas internas)
  • Oportunidade de impacto real em um produto com base de milhões de registros
  • Ambiente de inovação com autonomia técnica e exposição a decisões estratégicas
  • Plano de desenvolvimento profissional e acesso ao MBRAS Academy

PROCESSO SELETIVO

Etapa 1

Triagem de currículo/ Entrevista análise de perfil e portfólio

Etapa 2

Entrevista técnica com o Head de Tecnologia

Etapa 3

Desafio técnico prático (Full Stack + integração de API)

Etapa 4

Entrevista cultural com a liderança

Etapa 5

Proposta

MBRAS • Onde luxo encontra tecnologia

title: DevOps Pleno - Híbrido - Butantã (SP)
description:
Quem somos nós?

Somos um ecossistema de transformação digital que combina tecnologia e visão estratégica para escalar resultados e aumentar o valor entregue aos nossos clientes. Trabalhamos na construção de soluções inovadoras e disruptivas em mais de 300 projetos com grandes empresas nacionais de múltiplos segmentos.

  • Meios de Comunicação: Utilizamos E-mail e WhatsApp. Certifique-se de que essas informações estejam corretas no momento de inscrição para evitar falhas na comunicação.

O que buscamos?

Estamos em busca de um(a) DevOps Engineer para fazer parte do nosso movimento, com forte atuação em ambientes cloud e ecossistemas containerizados. Essa pessoa será responsável por garantir a eficiência, confiabilidade e escalabilidade das aplicações ao longo de todo o seu ciclo de vida — da estruturação da infraestrutura à operação em produção.

Como será seu dia-a-dia?

  • Gerenciar e evoluir ambientes em cloud, garantindo escalabilidade, segurança e alta disponibilidade
  • Implementar e manter infraestrutura como código, promovendo padronização e governança dos ambientes
  • Desenvolver e otimizar pipelines de CI/CD, assegurando entregas automatizadas e confiáveis
  • Apoiar a estruturação e melhoria de ambientes Kubernetes
  • Monitorar aplicações e infraestrutura, atuando de forma preventiva e corretiva quando necessário
  • Automatizar rotinas operacionais e propor melhorias contínuas nos processos
  • Atuar na resolução de incidentes e/ou na implementação de melhorias estruturais
  • Colaborar com times multidisciplinares, apoiando decisões técnicas e evoluções arquiteturais

Para cumprir esse desafio, você precisa dominar:

  • Experiência sólida com Kubernetes, atuando em ambientes produtivos
  • Vivência prática com Cloud (AWS e GCP)
  • Experiência com Infraestrutura como Código, especialmente Terraform
  • Experiência com práticas de GitOps, utilizando Argo CD
  • Experiência com CI/CD, principalmente utilizando GitLab CI, incluindo:criação e manutenção de pipelines, estratégias de deploy automatizado, integração com ambientes Kubernetes e versionamento e controle de releases
  • Experiência com ferramentas de observabilidade, como Datadog, New Relic ou Dynatrace
  • Experiência com containers (Docker)
  • Vivência com troubleshooting e sustentação de ambientes críticos

O que oferecemos aos nossos Builders?

  • Programa de Pontos Flexíveis em seu Caju - um valor fléxivel para você usar como você quiser;

title: Senior Data Scientist (MDM)
description:
We are looking for an experienced Senior Data Scientist (MDM) to join global projects in master-data intelligence. In this role, you will own the end-to-end development of ML models that reconstruct business rules from SAP and non-SAP data and drive best practices that ensure our adaptive rule engines scale with the business.

Key Responsibilities

  • Architect, build, and optimize PySpark-based ML pipelines that infer hidden business logic from millions of legacy records
  • Lead technical design reviews and establish MLOps standards for adaptive rule-discovery systems
  • Collaborate with data engineers, SAP functional leads, and business analysts to translate undocumented behaviors into validated, high-confidence business rules
  • Diagnose and resolve performance bottlenecks, data-drift issues, and cross-platform inconsistencies in real-time inference jobs
  • Mentor junior and mid-level engineers through pair programming, code reviews, and knowledge-sharing sessions on large-scale feature engineering
  • Own release planning, CI/CD pipelines, and automated testing strategies to maintain >95 % model-accuracy benchmarks

Need to Haves

  • 5+ years of production experience with PySpark, Databricks, and Azure cloud services
  • Proven track record of delivering scalable, high-performance ML solutions for pattern recognition and rule inference
  • Strong English skills—comfortable presenting model decisions to stakeholders and writing detailed RFCs
  • Demonstrated leadership in driving data-science excellence and mentoring teams

Nice to Haves

  • Deep domain expertise in master-data management (golden records, lineage, MDM quality frameworks)
  • Experience building and governing enterprise-grade ML feature stores or adaptive rule libraries
  • Proficiency with SAP MDG and understanding of SAP master-data structures

title: Associate Teacher, Primary Division
description:
Company Description

Welcome to Avenues São Paulo! Since our doors opened in August 2018, we've been on a mission to provide a truly transformative educational experience. Through immersive English language learning and dynamic interdisciplinary projects, we prepare our students to become future worldwise leaders uniquely equipped to understand and solve global-scale problems. As part of the Nord Anglia Education network, we're proud to stand alongside Avenues New York, shaping the future of education together. With a vibrant community of over 1100 students, ranging from as young as 18 months old through to graduation, our campus buzzes with a culture of innovation, creativity, collaboration, and state-of-the-art technology. Join us as we embark on a journey of lifelong learning and growth and discover why there's no place quite like Avenues São Paulo.

Job Description

Deep Collaboration, Constant Evolution

Collaboration here isn't a buzzword: it's woven into everything we do. At Avenues, no one teaches on an island. Substantial time to collaborate is embedded into the schedule. Teacher teams, across multiple disciplines, design learning experiences together for a whole grade level. This intensity of collaboration is challenging as well as exciting: we're always evolving, learning from each other and seeking to improve.

Language Immersion

Avenues students will graduate fluent in a second language and at ease beyond their borders. To this end, in grades N-1 students will be in a full English immersion program and from grades 2-5, Portuguese will take on a prominent place in the classroom.

As an Avenues Associate Teacher, you will:

  • Support lead teachers to develop and teach curriculum across multiple subjects that engages all learners in meaningful, challenging work that cultivates 21st-century skills
  • Help ensure that all students achieve key learning outcomes for the grade level, targeting instruction thoughtfully to address individual needs
  • Build a robust learning atmosphere that leads students to value being at school and feel part of a rigorous but joyful learning community
  • Collaborate intensively and daily with colleagues to continually improve student learning and school culture
  • Participate actively in ongoing, intensive professional learning

*Please note that this is a temporary position to cover a maternity leave.*

Qualifications

  • Student teaching, teacher training or equivalent experience with children ages 3-8
  • Deep dedication to learning and developing the craft of teaching
  • Highly effective collaborator, eager to listen deeply, contribute to a team and achieve goals together
  • Very resourceful and adaptive, eager to embrace constant change, growth and learning
  • Bachelor’s degree required, master’s degree preferred

Additional Information

Avenues is deeply committed to diversity, equity and inclusion throughout our organization. We strive to uphold a culture in which every colleague feels that they belong, are trusted, and are valued. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds, and strongly encourage candidates from traditionally underrepresented communities or groups to apply. Avenues offers competitive compensation and a generous benefits package.

Avenues upholds the highest standards for safeguarding the physical and emotional wellbeing of children. As an essential aspect of this commitment, all offers are contingent upon successful completion of careful reference and background checks.

title: Analista Sênior de SGI
description:

Um grupo referência em transporte e logística, além de atuação em diversos segmentos de negócios movidos por milhares de pessoas dispostas a darem o seu melhor, todos os dias. Somos plurais por natureza, um grupo diverso em negócios e pessoas. Acreditamos que as diferenças somam e movimentam, e é por isso que o Grupo SADA quer conhecer você. Todas as nossas vagas são extensivas as Pessoas com Deficiência e profissionais reabilitados do INSS. Quem sabe alguma oportunidade combina com você.

Analista Sênior de SGI.

Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista de SGI com um perfil mobilizador, com uma visão analítica aos processos de qualidade, possuindo experiências prévias no ramo logístico e automotivo.

Principais responsabilidades

  • Revisar e Construir análises de Indicadores de Qualidade;
  • Supervisionar no processo de implantação de novos projetos ou iniciativas ao Sistema de Gestão Integrado;
  • Conduzir e Reportar auditorias internas nas unidades de Transporte e Logística do Grupo;
  • Mobilizar iniciativas para a aderências das normas ISO 9001, ISO 14001 e ISO 45001 ;
  • Atuar em conjunto as demais equipe da qualidade para a identificação de Não Conformidades na linha operacional;
  • Atendimento à Auditoria Externa.

Pré-requisitos

  • Conhecimento técnico sólido em SGI e ferramentas da Qualidade;
  • Capacidade analítica para o acompanhamento e construção de Indicadores;
  • Formação e Conhecimento Prático nas Normas ISO 9001, ISO 14001 e ISO 45001 ;
  • Experiência na Condução de Auditorias Internas e Atendimento à Auditoria Externa;
  • Ensino superior completo;
  • Vivência prévia em controladoria, contabilidade, finanças, fiscal ou correlatas;
  • Disponibilidade para viagens.

O que oferecemos

  • Oportunidade de Crescimento e atuação estratégica;
  • Ambiente com alto contato com lideranças;
  • Desenvolvimento Profissional em um grupo de grande porte .

Nossos Benefícios

Saúde & Bem-Estar

• Plano de saúde Unimed (extensivo aos dependentes) e odontológico

• Gympass

• Wellz (sessões de terapia online custeadas pela empresa)

• Programa Cuidar

Desenvolvimento & Crescimento

• Treinamentos internos

Qualidade de Vida & Estrutura

• Clube SESI

• Horário de trabalho flexível

Aqui você encontrará um ambiente dinâmico, com autonomia, foco em resultados e oportunidade real de crescimento.

Interessados(as) podem se candidatar pelo link

NOSSA HISTÓRIA

Para contar a história do nosso grupo empresarial precisamos voltar ao Brasil dos anos 70, quando um jovem visionário desembarcava da Europa trazendo objetivos bem audaciosos. Ali, iniciava a trajetória da SADA, com a implantação de uma pequena transportadora na região metropolitana de Belo Horizonte.

Fundada em 4 de agosto de 1976, na cidade de Contagem, em Minas Gerais, a SADA Transportes e Armazéns S/A é criada, a partir da necessidade de atender as demandas de armazenagem e distribuição automobilística no país.

Sete anos depois, em 1983, a empresa é transferida para Betim em um terreno de cerca de 31 mil metros quadrados, 23 vezes menor que a área ocupada pela empresa atualmente.

“Ainda muito jovem, cheguei aqui vindo da Itália com a tarefa de montar a SADA no Brasil junto com a chegada da Fiat”, conta Vittorio Medioli, fundador presidente do Grupo SADA.

Assim como seu precursor, a origem do nome SADA também é italiana:

TRADIÇÃO EM CRESCER

Apesar das dificuldades políticas e econômicas da época, a empresa estabeleceu uma tradição em crescer, valorizando o trabalho em equipe e as habilidades individuais dos colaboradores em um ambiente onde todos se sentem orgulhosos de construir uma história de solidez e grandes conquistas.

title: Senior/Staff Platform Software Engineer (PHP/Angular)
description:
We are looking for a full-time, remote Senior/Staff Platform Software Engineer with 7+ years of experience to join our U.S. client. The role focuses on designing, building, and evolving the foundational systems that power the products. This role requires an experienced engineer with strong hands-on expertise in PHP and TypeScript (Angular) who can operate with minimal oversight and deliver pragmatic, customer-focused solutions.

The ideal candidate is an engineer who already possesses deep technical expertise, architectural judgment, and product-oriented thinking — and can apply those skills immediately in a production environment.

Our client provides integrated software and marketing solutions for the hospitality industry, specializing in short-term rental management. Their platform provides vacation rental companies with an enterprise-class property management system integrating booking, guest communications, and financial reporting systems - all built with partner organization integrations in mind.

Responsibilities

  • Design and implement scalable platform services using PHP as a primary backend language
  • Build and maintain frontend systems using TypeScript and Angular
  • Architect and evolve shared platform capabilities used across multiple products and teams
  • Translate product requirements into pragmatic, maintainable technical solutions
  • Apply Domain-Driven Design (DDD) principles and architectural modeling to complex business domains
  • Make sound tradeoffs between ideal architecture and practical delivery timelines
  • Build and integrate systems leveraging LLM-based tools to accelerate development workflows
  • Design and implement features powered by LLMs and agent-based systems, including orchestration, evaluation, and observability
  • Improve engineering velocity through tooling, automation, and thoughtful system design
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with product and design teams to ensure technical decisions align with customer needs
  • Contribute to cloud architecture decisions and ensure systems are scalable, secure, and cost-aware

Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 7+ years of professional software engineering experience
  • Deep, production-grade experience with PHP
  • Strong front-end development experience using TypeScript and Angular
  • Experience designing and operating distributed systems in production
  • Strong understanding of API design, RESTful services, and event-driven systems and solid knowledge of relational databases and data modeling
  • Practical experience applying Domain-Driven Design (DDD) concepts and architectural models (layered architecture, hexagonal/clean architecture, event-driven architecture, etc.)
  • Demonstrated ability to evolve legacy systems incrementally
  • Ability to design systems that balance correctness, scalability, cost, and delivery speed
  • Hands-on experience deploying and operating systems in AWS, with familiarity with core AWS services (e.g., EC2, ECS/EKS, Lambda, RDS, S3, API Gateway, CloudWatch, IAM) and strong understanding of cloud-native patterns, scalability, reliability, and cost optimization
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code (e.g., Terraform, CloudFormation, CDK) is strongly preferred
  • Hands-on experience using LLM-based tools in daily development workflows
  • Experience integrating LLM APIs into production systems
  • Familiarity with prompt design, evaluation strategies, and reliability patterns
  • Ideally: experience building features or internal tools powered by LLM agents, including orchestration, tool use, guardrails, and monitoring
  • Strong product mindset with p ragmatic decision-maker — prioritizes customer impact over theoretical purity and avoids dogmatic adherence to patterns or tools
  • Experience making technical tradeoffs in ambiguous environments
  • Ability to reason about cost, complexity, maintainability, and time-to-market
  • Highly self-motivated and accountable, with the ability to drive initiatives independently from concept to production with minimal oversight
  • Comfortable operating in environments with evolving requirements

Desired Experience

  • Experience with other major cloud providers (GCP or Azure) is a plus
  • Experience defining platform strategy or technical direction across teams
  • Experience mentoring engineers and raising overall engineering standards
  • Proven track record of modernizing systems at scale
  • Experience designing developer platforms or internal tooling ecosystems
  • Strong opinions loosely held — able to debate rigorously and adapt when new information emerges

Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Lets learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent that enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Supply Chain Analyst
description:
Analista de Auditoria Logística (SP) | Supply Chain Analyst

Assegurar o cumprimento dos processos operacionais nos Centros de Distribuição (CDs) que impactam a quebra conhecida e desconhecida, atuando como ponto de conexão entre os CDs e os Auditores Sênior do país, por meio do monitoramento de recebimentos, expedições e controles críticos, e da geração de alertas antecipados de risco por mercadoria não recebida na loja.

Como Parte De Rappi, Serás Responsable De

Monitorar Diariamente Processos Críticos Do CD

  • Recebimento de mercadoria.
  • Cross-docking.
  • Expedição para lojas.
  • Confirmações de recebimento em loja.
  • Cumprimento de contagens cíclicas (inventário rotativo).

Gestão De Riscos e Alertas

  • Detectar e reportar alertas de Missing Reception (CD → loja).
  • Monitorar o fluxo de separação e saída de TRs (Transferências) para as lojas.
  • Assegurar o cumprimento de IN & OUT (Entrada e Saída) do CD.

Validação e Consistência

  • Validar a consistência entre o WMS do CD, documentação logística e confirmações de recebimento em loja.

Reporte e Visibilidade

  • Consolidar e priorizar incidentes de quebra originados no CD.
  • Dar visibilidade ao Auditor do país sobre:
  • Riscos recorrentes por CD.
  • Processos operacionais não cumpridos.
  • Casos de alto impacto econômico.

Suporte e Auditoria

  • Acompanhar investigações lideradas pelo Auditor do país.
  • Manter evidências e rastreabilidade dos achados (findings) no CD.
  • Apoiar a padronização de controles operacionais nos CDs

Bien y ahora, ¿Cuáles son los requisitos para que yo sea parte de este universo de neón?

Educação: Profissional em Logística, Engenharia, Administração ou Economia.

Experiência: 2 a 4 anos em Centros de Distribuição ou Prevenção de Perdas (Loss Prevention).

Sistemas: Domínio de WMS e Excel Avançado (capacidade de cruzar bancos de dados complexos).

Habilidade Chave: Análise crítica para detectar "Missing Reception" (mercadoria enviada, mas não recebida).

Idiomas: Espanhol ou Inglês intermediário (para relatórios regionais, não eliminatório).

Localização: Residir em São Paulo (vaga presencial).

Experiência em startups, marketplaces, logística ou última milha (last mile) é altamente valorizada

Rappi Technology Brazil

Buscamos um Data Security Engineer para atuar como referência técnica na proteção de dados e segurança da informação. Essa posição será responsável por desenhar, implementar e monitorar controles de segurança ao longo de todo o ciclo de vida dos dados , garantindo que as informações críticas da organização sejam tratadas com o nível adequado de proteção, governança e conformidade.

O profissional atuará de forma transversal com áreas de Tecnologia, Governança de Dados, Cibersegurança, Jurídico e Negócios , contribuindo para fortalecer a cultura de segurança da informação, reduzir riscos e garantir aderência às políticas corporativas de proteção de dados.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Projetar e implementar controles técnicos de segurança de dados ao longo de todo o ciclo de vida da informação (criação, armazenamento, processamento, compartilhamento e descarte).
  • Integrar controles de segurança em fluxos e processos de dados , garantindo aderência aos princípios de governança e classificação da informação.
  • Desenvolver e aplicar modelos de acesso baseados no princípio do menor privilégio , garantindo acesso seguro às informações críticas.
  • Atuar no monitoramento técnico de riscos e incidentes relacionados a dados , identificando comportamentos anômalos e acessos indevidos.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com equipes de Cibersegurança, Engenharia de Dados e TI na implementação e validação de controles técnicos.
  • Apoiar processos de auditoria, conformidade e gestão de riscos , garantindo rastreabilidade e transparência no uso de dados.
  • Oferecer suporte técnico aos papéis de governança de dados (Data Owners, Data Stewards e Data Custodians).
  • Promover boas práticas e iniciativas de conscientização em segurança da informação , fortalecendo a cultura de proteção de dados na organização.
  • Atuar como ponto focal de segurança da informação para a operação no Brasil , alinhando as práticas locais às políticas corporativas globais.

Conhecimento Técnico

  • Experiência em governança de dados , incluindo domínios, metadados, linhagem, qualidade e classificação da informação.
  • Conhecimento avançado em segurança de dados e proteção da informação ao longo de todo o ciclo de vida dos dados.
  • Experiência na implementação de modelos de controle de acesso, gestão de permissões e segregação de funções .
  • Conhecimento em engenharia de dados segura , incluindo integração de controles em pipelines de ingestão, transformação e consumo de dados.
  • Compreensão de arquiteturas modernas de dados , ambientes analíticos e plataformas em nuvem.
  • Conhecimento em privacidade de dados e tratamento de dados pessoais .
  • Experiência com auditorias técnicas, análise de riscos e revisões de conformidade .
  • Capacidade de traduzir diretrizes corporativas em configurações e práticas técnicas operacionais .

Certificações desejáveis:

  • Microsoft Security, Compliance & Identity Fundamentals (SC-900)
  • Microsoft Information Protection Administrator (SC-400)

title: Engenheiro(a) de Melhoria Contínua
description:
Resumo do cargo:

A pessoa Engenheira de Melhoria Contínua será responsável por analisar dados, identificar lacunas de desempenho, liderar iniciativas de melhoria e apoiar a adoção de ferramentas Oracle. Atuará de forma colaborativa com diversas áreas para elevar níveis de serviço, impulsionar crescimento e contribuir para maior eficiência operacional e financeira.

Nesse cargo, suas responsabilidades serão:

  • Analisar dados de clientes, mercado e operações internas para identificar oportunidades de melhoria, gargalos e variações de desempenho entre mercados e portfólios.
  • Transformar conjuntos complexos de dados em insights acionáveis, sustentando decisões estratégicas e priorização de iniciativas.
  • Liderar e apoiar programas de eliminação de gargalos, identificando restrições, quantificando impactos e facilitando alinhamento entre áreas.

  • Conduzir e apoiar eventos de Melhoria Contínua por meio de análises de processos, levantamento de dados e acompanhamento pós‑implementação.
  • Monitorar e reportar continuamente o desempenho de Service Level da área de Flow Controls, garantindo visibilidade, responsabilização e resultados sustentáveis.
  • Atuar como elo entre times de negócio e funcionalidades Oracle, contribuindo para adoção, aprimoramentos e uso eficiente de novos e atuais recursos.
  • Facilitar implementação de ferramentas Oracle, traduzindo necessidades de negócio em casos de uso, apoiando testes, treinamentos e gestão de mudança.
  • Construir parcerias fortes em uma organização matricial, alinhando partes interessadas em torno de metas comuns e análises baseadas em dados.
  • Atuar com autonomia desde a definição do problema até a implementação da solução e a realização dos benefícios.
  • Comunicar de forma clara problemas, causas‑raiz e soluções, utilizando dados para apoiar decisões e promover alinhamento entre equipes diversas.

Quem você é:

Você toma decisões com base em dados e busca constantemente maneiras mais eficientes de melhorar processos. Consegue simplificar temas complexos, adaptando sua comunicação a diferentes públicos. Trabalha bem em ambientes colaborativos, influenciando sem autoridade formal e construindo relacionamentos de confiança. Mantém foco em resultados, atua com autonomia e enfrenta desafios com curiosidade e agilidade.

Para este cargo, você precisará:

  • Formação em TI, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência mínima de 4–5 anos em melhoria contínua ou business intelligence.
  • Conhecimentos desejáveis em programação (SQL, R, Python) e vivência em áreas industriais ou logísticas — experiência com válvulas de controle é um diferencial.
  • Experiência com sistemas ERP, preferencialmente Oracle.
  • Conhecimento em mapeamento de processos e metodologias de causa‑raiz (Lean, Six Sigma, PDCA, 5 Porquês).
  • Habilidade em mensuração de performance e acompanhamento de KPIs.
  • Experiência em técnicas de eliminação de gargalos e otimização de fluxo.
  • Desenvolvimento de business intelligence e transformação de dados complexos em insights.
  • Conhecimento em processos interfuncionais (Vendas, Operações, Supply Chain, Finanças).
  • Noções de gestão de projetos (escopo, priorização, acompanhamento de benefícios).
  • Inglês fluente; espanhol desejável.
  • Local da vaga: Sorocaba.
  • Disponibilidade para viagens ocasionais.

Nossa Cultura e compromisso com você:

Na Emerson, priorizamos um local de trabalho onde todos os colaboradores sejam valorizados, respeitados e capacitados para crescer. Promovemos um ambiente que incentiva a inovação, a colaboração e perspectivas diversas, porque sabemos que grandes ideias vêm de grandes equipes. Nosso compromisso com o desenvolvimento contínuo da carreira e o crescimento de uma cultura inclusiva garantem que você tenha o apoio para prosperar. Seja por meio de orientação, treinamento ou oportunidades de liderança, investimos no seu sucesso para que você possa causar um impacto duradouro. Acreditamos que equipes diversas, trabalhando juntas, são fundamentais para impulsionar o crescimento e entregar resultados de negócios.

Reconhecemos a importância do bem-estar dos colaboradores. Oferecemos convênios médico, odontológico, farmácia e Wellhub (Gympass); seguro de vida; cooperativa de crédito; previdência privada; reconhecimento e muito mais. Nossa cultura de apoio às nossas pessoas oferece grupos de recursos e programa de assistência aos colaboradores, além de licença parental estendida (materna e paterna) por ser Empresa Cidadã.

description:
Pioneirismo que nos orgulha, responsabilidade que nos guia.

Muito além de uma divulgação de vaga, este é um convite para você fazer parte de uma história pioneira, que une inovação, responsabilidade socioambiental e relevância estratégica no cenário global da mineração de terras raras.

Somos a Mineração Serra Verde e operamos uma unidade integrada de mineração e processamento de terras raras em Minaçu-GO. Os elementos de terras raras (ETRs) de alto valor que a Serra Verde fornece, são essenciais para a produção de ímãs permanentes usados nos setores de energia, transporte, aeroespacial e eletrônico.

Iniciamos a produção comercial na Fase I do nosso depósito Pela Ema, abrigando um dos maiores depósitos de argila iônica fora da Ásia, com vantagens competitivas e ambientais devido à natureza do depósito, com impactos ambientais relativamente baixos e situado em uma área de mineração consolidada, próxima à infraestrutura de energia renovável.

Na Serra Verde, nossos valores nos guiam diariamente: atuamos com integridade, confiança e transparência. Valorizamos a excelência. Criamos e compartilhamos valor sustentável. Somos otimistas e apaixonados. Assumimos a responsabilidade pessoal. Somos corajosos e empreendedores.

As inscrições também estão abertas para pessoas com deficiência (PCDs), mulheres e grupos prioritários, em conformidade com os princípios de inclusão e equidade.

Como você poderá contribuir?

Buscamos um profissional com sólida experiência em ambientes corporativos estruturados, que una expertise técnica a uma visão estratégica de negócio. O candidato ideal possui histórico comprovado em gestão fiscal, forte capacidade de priorização e cumprimento rigoroso dos prazos legais. Além disso, demonstra atenção meticulosa aos detalhes e habilidade para analisar grandes volumes de informações com precisão.

Valorizamos alguém proativo, que não apenas execute rotinas, mas proponha melhorias contínuas, identifique oportunidades de otimização tributária e contribua para a eficiência dos processos fiscais. Procuramos um perfil comprometido, colaborativo e alinhado a um ambiente de trabalho saudável e com boa convivência.

Quais conhecimentos, vivências e requisitos você vai precisar para esta posição?

Para atuar nesta posição, é necessário possuir educação superior completa, preferencialmente em Contabilidade ou áreas correlatas. Também é essencial contar com, no mínimo, cinco anos de experiência em gestão fiscal e tributária, incluindo apuração de impostos, escrituração fiscal, compliance tributário e suporte em auditorias.

Você precisará demonstrar experiência sólida em rotinas fiscais, conhecimento aprofundado da legislação tributária brasileira, domínio de sistemas fiscais (ERP/SPED) e familiaridade com tributos federais e estaduais, especialmente no contexto do estado de Goiás.

Somos convictos de que o sucesso está diretamente ligado ao bem-estar e ao desenvolvimento das pessoas. Por isso, oferecemos benefícios que vão além do cuidado profissional. Buscamos criar um ambiente equilibrado, que respeite as demandas da organização e, ao mesmo tempo, valorize as necessidades pessoais de cada colaborador. Cada investimento é um cuidado com o nosso futuro.

title: Senior Data Engineer (Node.js / TypeScript)
description:
Job Title: Senior Data Engineer (Node.js / TypeScript)

Location: Remote – Brazil

Job Description

We are seeking a Senior Data Engineer with strong Node.js and TypeScript expertise to build scalable backend systems and data services. The ideal candidate will have recent hands-on experience with Node.js , strong database expertise in MongoDB and SQL , and experience building high-performance APIs .

This role focuses on designing and developing scalable backend services that support high-volume data processing and integration across digital platforms. Experience with GraphQL is preferred but not mandatory.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend services using Node.js and TypeScript .
  • Build and optimize REST/GraphQL APIs for high-performance data access and integration.
  • Develop and maintain data models and database schemas across MongoDB and SQL databases .
  • Implement scalable data ingestion and processing pipelines .
  • Work with distributed systems in a cloud-based environment .
  • Ensure performance optimization, reliability, and scalability of backend services.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams including product, architecture, and engineering.
  • Participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies such as sprint planning, stand-ups, and retrospectives.
  • Follow DevOps best practices , including CI/CD, testing, and monitoring.

Required Skills

  • 5+ years of experience in backend engineering or data engineering .
  • Strong recent hands-on experience with Node.js .
  • Proficiency in TypeScript and JavaScript .
  • Strong experience with MongoDB and SQL databases .
  • Experience building REST APIs or GraphQL APIs .
  • Solid understanding of data modeling and database design .
  • Experience working in cloud environments (AWS preferred) .
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, testing frameworks, and modern development practices .

Nice to Have

  • Experience with GraphQL architecture or schema design .
  • Experience with distributed systems and high transaction platforms .
  • Knowledge of ETL pipelines and data processing frameworks .
  • Experience working in digital media, sports, or high-scale consumer platforms .

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field , or equivalent practical experience.

title: Software Developer
description:
The Company:

Hexagon is a global leader in digital reality solutions, combining sensor, software, and autonomous technologies. We are putting data to work to boost efficiency, productivity, quality, and safety across industrial, manufacturing, infrastructure, public sector, and mobility applications.

Our technologies are shaping the production and people-related ecosystems to become increasingly connected and autonomous — ensuring a scalable, sustainable future.

Hexagon’s Mining division solves surface and underground mine challenges with proven technologies for planning, operations, and safety.

Hexagon (Nasdaq Stockholm: HEXA B) has approximately 24,000 employees in 50 countries and net sales of approximately 5.5bn USD. Learn more at hexagon.com and follow us @HexagonAB.

Purpose of Position:

Hexagon Mining develops intelligent collision avoidance systems for large vehicles used mainly in open-pit mining. Its products integrate satellite navigation, digital radio, multiple sensors and actuation systems as well as sophisticated algorithms to reliably predict dangerous scenarios and prevent accidents. It employs approx. 100 R&D staff in several attractive international locations. The software developer will join the team to develop this solution.

  • Collaborate closely with the hardware, firmware, and backend service development teams to realize new integrated solutions.
  • Assist the product-introduction team and gain first-hand experience with our products.
  • Bring in innovative ideas for further development.

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Control and Automation Engineering, Electrical Engineering or equivalent;
  • Experience in C and C++ on embedded or Linux systems;
  • MQTT and other IoT related protocols, networking technologies in general, and related network security aspects;
  • Full professional English proficiency;
  • Team oriented and able to work independently;
  • Positive working attitude and good common sense to understand business requirements;
  • Willing to travel overseas occasionally;

Knowledge and Experience - Desired:

  • Web technologies, React.js.
  • Knowledge of OpenWRT and Yocto
  • Knowledge of additional high-level language, e.g., Python, C#.
  • Development and/or maintenance of software for safety-critical, automotive, real-time or control systems
  • Development of localization, navigation, or perception systems based on technologies such as GNSS, radio, UWB, automotive radars, and IMUs.
  • Implementation of CAN, Ethernet, I2C, RS-232 or SPI-based drivers.
  • Functional Safety.
  • Experience with Test-Driven Design, Continuous Integration, and agile development processes (e.g., Scrum).

Travel:

  • 5-10%

Benefits:

You will work on products that could revolutionize the mining industry in the next 5 years. Your colleagues consist of highly qualified and open-minded engineers from all over the world. Beside the developer career you will have the opportunity to develop into multiple directions like project management, product management, customer support and sales.

Join our team as a software developer and make a significant impact on our clients' digital transformation initiatives. We offer a stimulating work environment, competitive compensation package, and opportunities for professional growth. Apply now and help shape the future of Hexagon’s technology solutions.

title: Pharmaceutical Field Specialist
description:
Job title: Field Specialist, Brazil

Job Type: Project-related part-time work (working hours depend on availability, but if you are working on a project, we ask for 1-3 days per week).

Are you looking for something flexible? Do you have sales, marketing or market research experience within Pharmaceutical or Healthcare industries? Are you interested in joining a fast-paced and growing global organisation?

Job Purpose:

We are looking for a Field Specialist to join our Brazil team. This role will shadow pharmaceutical representatives for the day and prepare a report based on observations made while working with the representative as they interact with their customers. The position is appointment based, depending on the size of the project and number of field days required. The position would be suitable for someone looking for project-related part-time work that leads to a long-term collaboration.

Role Responsibilities:

  • Contacting sales representatives to arrange a shadowing day in the field
  • Observing interactions between sales representatives and customers without disrupting their day (primarily face to face)
  • Conducting a 60–90-minute interview with the sales representative during the field day
  • Submitting structured reports (workbooks), translated into English, after each day in the field based on observations made within 24-48 hours of field visit
  • Attending a 30-60 min online session prior to each project to understand the project objectives and share feedback
  • Participate in project debrief calls and potentially provide feedback to assist in the development of final recommendations

Person Specification:

  • Experience in sales, marketing or market research within Pharmaceutical or Healthcare industries
  • Fluent command of Portuguese and English (written and oral)
  • Bachelor’s degree – marketing, science, or data focus is preferred
  • When working on a project, have 1-3 days availability during the week
  • Flexibility to work from morning to evening
  • Flexibility to travel within the country
  • Strong attention to detail and excellent listener
  • Confident user of Microsoft Excel

Opportunity:

  • Work with a successful and well-established company with an enviable growth trajectory
  • Working with 29 out of top 30 pharmaceutical companies globally
  • Great flexibility in managing the workload and opportunity to travel within the country
  • Structured and on-going training system and working with strong management team

If you would like to apply for this position, please submit your CV in ENGLISH .

About STEM:

STEM Healthcare is a dynamic, fast paced global pharmaceutical and life science, commercial benchmarking firm headquartered in the UK and present across six continents. STEM have developed an audit process and built a benchmarking database with more than 500,000 face-to-face observations completed across 52 countries. The benchmark provided is unique in the pharmaceutical industry consisting of over 100 KPIs, while focusing on 2-3 key priorities during formulation of action planning in order to help clients further accelerate performance.

STEM accelerates performance, improves strategic alignment, and facilitates excellence in marketing, medical, market access and account plans strategy execution. Due to the unique, specialised and highly targeted offering, STEM is experiencing a rapid growth phase, and recruiting heavily across the world. New employees will be joining at a time where rapid career development and growth opportunities are expected, as the organisation works towards their mid and long-term goals.

Vision: To always be viewed as an essential partner in enabling our clients to reach more patients with their medicines

Mission: To accelerate high performance

Core Values: Brave, Honest, Performance Driven, Practical, Customer Focused, Caring

Find us here:

Website:

STEM Healthcare will consider all qualified applicants for employment without discrimination on grounds of disability, sex or sexual orientation, pregnancy or maternity leave status, race or national or ethnic origin, age, religion or belief, gender identity or re-assignment, marital or civil partnership status, protected veteran status (if applicable) or any other characteristic protected by law. STEM Healthcare only employs individuals with the right to work in the country/ies where the role is advertised.

title: Finance Business Partner | Accounts Receivable
description:
About Pinnacle Group

Pinnacle Group is a leading workforce solutions and technology services provider delivering innovative, results-driven solutions to global enterprises. With deep expertise in financial operations, staffing models, and program management, we help organizations optimize performance while maintaining strong compliance and operational excellence. Our finance team plays a critical role in supporting scalable growth, operational efficiency, and exceptional client experiences across diverse programs.

Summary

The Finance Business Partner will lead Pinnacle Group’s Accounts Receivable operations while serving as a strategic advisor to client-facing business teams. This role is approximately 70% operational, overseeing billing, collections, reconciliations, supplier payments, and team performance, and 30% focused on financial partnership and business support. The ideal candidate will bring strong leadership, analytical expertise, and a client-service mindset to improve AR performance and drive financial excellence. This position is instrumental in ensuring accurate cash flow management, client satisfaction, and continuous process improvement.

Job Description

Accounts Receivable Management

  • Oversee the full AR lifecycle including invoicing, collections, reconciliations, dispute resolution, and aging analysis.
  • Ensure accurate and timely billing while resolving client exceptions efficiently.
  • Monitor client payments, oversee cash application, and ensure timely settlement reconciliation to support 100% on-time supplier payment SLAs.
  • Partner with Accounts Payable and Treasury to align receivables with cash flow forecasts and payment schedules.
  • Monitor receivables aging and collaborate with client stakeholders and PMO teams to resolve payment inquiries.
  • Manage quarterly client and supplier volume rebates with precision and compliance.
  • Standardize AR policies, procedures, and playbooks across programs while maintaining audit readiness and strong internal controls.
  • Drive automation and continuous improvement initiatives to enhance AR efficiency and scalability.

Finance Business Partnering

  • Serve as the primary finance liaison to program leaders and account managers, supporting invoice-related issue resolution.
  • Provide actionable insights on billing behaviors, dispute trends, and invoicing challenges to improve program performance.
  • Present tailored AR reporting to leadership, highlighting risks, opportunities, and business impact.
  • Support onboarding of new client programs with structured billing guidance and financial playbooks.
  • Collaborate with Legal and Contracts to align billing terms and resolve disputes effectively.
  • Handle sensitive financial matters with discretion, urgency, and professionalism.

Team Management & Development

  • Lead and mentor a team of 2–4 AR analysts across onshore and offshore locations.
  • Manage hiring, training, workload distribution, and performance management in coordination with leadership.
  • Track and analyze AR KPIs including on-time billing, payment application, supplier payment SLAs, and resolution timelines.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, innovation, and proactive problem-solving.
  • Design and implement development plans to enhance team autonomy and operational excellence.

Technology & Systems

  • Manage AR modules within Workday and collaborate on system enhancements and integrations.
  • Review testing outcomes for system updates and approve AR-related production releases.
  • Contribute to the AR technology roadmap to support automation and process optimization initiatives.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, or related field.
  • Minimum 5 years of management experience in Accounts Receivable or related financial operations.
  • Strong knowledge of US GAAP and accounting principles.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel including pivot tables, VLOOKUPs, and data analysis.
  • Experience with Workday or other ERP/accounting systems.
  • Experience in the staffing industry or Pay-When-Paid programs preferred.
  • Proven leadership experience managing diverse teams and driving measurable performance improvements.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate financial data into business insights.

Why Join Pinnacle Group?

At Pinnacle Group, you will play a strategic role in shaping financial operations that directly impact business growth and client success. We foster a collaborative, high-performance culture where innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement are valued. This role offers significant visibility across business leadership, opportunities to influence process transformation, and the ability to build and develop a strong finance team. If you are driven by operational excellence and strategic impact, Pinnacle Group offers a platform to grow your leadership career.

title: Desenvolvedor(a) Full Stack Mobile Sênior

Idiomas:

Soft Skills:

  • Atenção aos detalhes
  • Comunicação escrita objetiva, concisa e consistente

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
We're looking for a DevOps / Cloud Lead who knows how to design, automate, and operate cloud infrastructure.

This role focuses heavily on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) due to a strategic partnership in that ecosystem. Many of our clients are migrating infrastructure to OCI or need help operating multi-cloud environments.

We need someone who can design solutions, automate processes, and solve infrastructure problems, not just maintain pipelines.

Why this role exists

We have a strategic partnership with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI). Clients are asking us to migrate infrastructure to OCI, and many of them also need ongoing DevOps operations and architecture support.

We need someone who can own this technically. Not just executing tasks, but executing the task is an important part of the job as well.

Design solutions. Talk to clients. Automate migrations. Coordinate engineers. And when necessary, jump in and fix things yourself.

TL;DR

You will help lead cloud and DevOps initiatives at Quave. Your job is to:

  • Lead cloud migrations to OCI
  • Design cloud architectures
  • Automate migrations and infrastructure
  • Coordinate DevOps engineers
  • Talk directly to clients
  • Help build repeatable DevOps processes

You must be strong in OCI, comfortable with AWS / Azure / GCP, hands-on, obsessed with automation, and comfortable discussing technical architecture with clients.

English is a plus, not required.

This is not a ticket-based DevOps job

If you're looking for a role where you maintain Jenkins pipelines, restart servers, open support tickets, and wait for instructions, this is not the role for you.

This role is about designing and solving infrastructure problems. We want someone who can look at a system and think:

"We can automate 80% of this."

And then actually build the automation.

What you'll actually do

Cloud Architecture Design infrastructure for systems running in OCI, AWS, Azure, and GCP, migrating from one to another.

Cloud Migrations

A lot of our work will be migrations like AWS → OCI, Azure → OCI, GCP → OCI.

Your job is not just to do the migration, but to help us turn migrations into repeatable processes, scripts, templates, automation and tooling so that each migration becomes easier than the last.

Automation

We want to automate everything that can be automated:

  • Automated infrastructure provisioning
  • Migration scripts
  • CI/CD pipelines
  • Environment replication
  • Monitoring setups

If you like writing scripts that replace hours of manual work, you'll enjoy this role.

Client Discussions

You will often join calls with clients to understand infrastructure problems, design migration strategies, estimate effort, and propose solutions. You must be comfortable discussing technical topics clearly.

Leading DevOps Engineers

As the DevOps work grows, you'll coordinate other engineers working on projects, reviewing architecture, guiding implementations, and ensuring quality.

What we're looking for

You probably have many years working with infrastructure. But more importantly, you have good instincts about systems.

You likely:

  • Love automating infrastructure
  • Hate manual processes
  • Can quickly understand unfamiliar systems
  • Are comfortable debugging production environments
  • Enjoy designing architectures
  • Can communicate clearly with both engineers and clients

You should also be comfortable using AI tools to accelerate your work. Tools like ChatGPT, Claude, and Cursor can dramatically increase productivity when used well. We expect you to take advantage of that.

Technical Expectations

Cloud

  • Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) - important
  • AWS
  • Azure
  • GCP

DevOps

  • Docker
  • Kubernetes
  • Terraform or other Infrastructure-as-Code tools
  • CI/CD pipelines
  • Linux systems administration
  • Networking fundamentals

Automation

Comfortable writing scripts in Bash, Python, Go, or similar.

Languages

Portuguese required. English is a plus as some clients are international, so it may eventually become useful in the future, but it's not required.

Why work with Quave

We are a small, profitable, independent company. No investors. No corporate bureaucracy. We focus on doing great work for clients and building great software.

Things we value: Speed. Quality. Pragmatism. Autonomy.

Quave literally stands for Quality (Qua) and Velocity (Ve).

Pay and Benefits

This is a full-time remote position. Compensation will depend on experience.

  • Fully remote work
  • Flexible hours
  • 22 days paid time off per year
  • Quarterly bonus based on company performance
  • AI allowance for productivity tools

We work as a distributed team of independent contractors.

Hiring Process

  1. Application review
  2. Technical conversation
  3. Architecture discussion
  4. Conversation(s) with one or more partners
  • This is a leadership role and you will coordinate other engineers as the DevOps work grows. But at Quave our leaders are hands-on. You should be comfortable writing automation and infrastructure code yourself when needed.

title: Domain Architect Networking
description:
Join one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world! Here you can transform your career!

Why join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for a Domain Architect Networking , who wants to learn and transform their career, in a CLT contract, hybrid , in the city of Belo Horizonte - MG.

Job Description:

The Domain Architect – Networking will play an essential role in the design, governance and evolution of the network architectures that support the digital, industrial and corporate operations of Brasil and Canada. He will be responsible for the strategic planning, specification, integration and optimization of corporate communication platforms: SD-WAN, LAN/WAN, OT/IT industrial networks, Wi-Fi, underground networks, data centers, cloud integration, 5G, satellite and edge for mining.

Its mission is to ensure robustness, availability, performance, security, and scalability – enabling automation, digitalization, advanced analytics, industrial IoT, and support for key critical environments. He will work directly with global IT, Operations, Security, and Engineering teams, supporting multicultural and multifunctional environment

Main Responsibilities

  • Lead the design, documentation and evolution of enterprise, industrial and mission-critical network architectures for global, underground, remote, mobile/IoT and cloud/hybrid operations.
  • Specify patterns, high and low complexity diagrams (logical view, physical, topology, VLAN, routing, SDN), considering redundancy, availability, performance, and resiliency.
  • Evaluate, select and supervise deployment of emerging technologies: SD-WAN, SDN, Zero Trust, private 5G, mesh networks, VPNs, segmentation of OT/IT networks in a mining environment.
  • Define and ensure compliance with global security standards (ISO 27001, NIST, LGPD, PIPEDA), encryption policies, access control, vulnerability mitigation, and incident response.
  • Lead network integration projects between Brazil, Canada, industrial areas/mines, offices, plants and data centers, enabling high connectivity, performance and security.
  • Orchestrate processes of technological update, equipment replacement, configuration automation and network monitoring, including SRE, observability, Service Mesh.
  • Create and maintain detailed documentation: diagrams, flows, contingency plans, playbooks, usage policies, governance, and technical templates.
  • Direct interface with Engineering, Operations, Security, DevOps, Industrial Automation teams, global architecture teams and strategic suppliers.
  • Monitor, optimize and evolve the communication infrastructure, aiming at maximum efficiency, IoT support, industrial analytics, autonomous mine operation and compliance.
  • Support the development of strategic projects (mining 4.0, edge computing, digital twins, cloud/industrial integration, ESG) and train internal teams.

Requirements and Competencies

Essential Requirements (Hard Skills)

  • Bachelor's degree in Network Engineering, Telecommunications, Computer Science or related.
  • Minimum of 8 years of solid experience as a network architect, working in critical industrial, enterprise/global, multinational and mining/resources environments.
  • Mastery of the main protocols, architectures and standards: TCP/IP, BGP, OSPF/EIGRP, IPv6, DNS/DHCP, VLAN/VRF, MPLS, Wi-Fi, SD-WAN, 5G/Edge, SASE, Zero Trust, OT/IT Convergence.
  • Real experience with Cisco (Switching, Routing, SD-WAN, SDA), Juniper, Arista, Palo Alto, Fortinet, Rockwell/Siemens industrial solutions, cloud networking platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP).
  • Practical interface with complex environments: underground/mining, industrial networks, industrial environments 4.0, cloud integration, high availability, disaster recovery.
  • Experience in network automation (Ansible, Terraform, Python, scripts), advanced monitoring (SNMP, NetFlow, SRE Observability).
  • Excellence in documentation, technical design, governance support, multi-platform integration and international performance with remote teams.
  • Fluent English (essential), for Brazil-Canada integration.

Soft Skills

  • Technical leadership, positive influence, consultative action and consensus building between teams and global cultures.
  • Strategic and analytical ability to plan, execute, and evolve complex, highly available architectures.
  • Clear and assertive communication with stakeholders at all levels, internationally distributed teams.
  • Proactivity, resilience, focus on solutions, adaptability and collaborative posture.
  • Absolute focus on results – operational, safety, innovation and support of infrastructure.

Differentials / Nice to Have:

  • Certificações: CCNP/CCIE, AWS/Azure/GCP Advanced Networking, CISSP, VMware NSX, ITIL Expert, TOGAF.
  • Experience in greenfield/brownfield projects, integration of industrial networks/IoT, edge/mesh/satellite, mine digitalization.
  • Experience with underground networks, mining-specific wireless solutions, industrial OT/IT environments, SRE/observability on a global scale.
  • Participation in technical forums, publications, international events, benchmarks, leadership in strategic projects from large mining companies.
  • Ability to work in different time zones, multi-site environments and multicultural teams.

Expected Skills & Deliverables, Impact:

  • Robust and secure reference architecture for all Brazil and Canada network environments, including integration, automation, performance and high availability.
  • Execution of strategic projects for technological evolution, digitalization, automation, analytics and ESG, supporting business results.
  • Dissemination of best practices, technical painting of the teams involved, development of governance policies and global operation.
  • Active performance in innovation, benchmarking and implementation of new technologies that support the group's digital and operational transformation.
  • Ensuring compliance, operational resilience, risk mitigation and increasing efficiency for operations.

Additional Comments:

This professional will be a protagonist in the transformation and support of corporate, industrial and critical network architecture, enabling the global Brazil-Canada operation and the group's digital/ESG evolution.

Por Que a GREEKy Studio é o Seu Próximo Passo? (A Parte Boa!)

Na GREEKy, o seu talento é visto e valorizado. Nossos pilares são:

  • Crescimento Acelerado: Somos uma agência em expansão, o que significa que você terá espaço para crescer junto, assumir novos desafios e deixar sua marca.
